description: This is a Zephyr RTOS kernel sample source file implementing a message dispatch system with multiple threads, latency measurement, and statistics reporting.

methods.name: metairq_fn
methods.description: Function for the metairq thread to fetch messages, measure latency, and dispatch to target thread queues.

methods.name: isqrt
methods.description: Recursive implementation of integer square root.

methods.name: calc_stats
methods.description: Calculates min, max, mean, and standard deviation of an array of latencies.

methods.name: record_latencies
methods.description: Records latency data, updates statistics, and triggers final report when all events are processed.

methods.name: thread_fn
methods.description: Worker thread function to process messages, simulate work, and record latencies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes message queues, creates worker threads, and starts message device.
